name: Movie Massacre 📼 [HORROR]
desc:
This game is based on a true story... ⚠️

After finishing school, you find a job working at a local VHS movie store secluded in the dense forest...
Try to survive the night shifts as the job that you thought would be easy turns into a nightmare like none other

🏆 Earn 1 completion to unlock the shack behind the movie store, and get a free weapon

🤫 There is a SECRET ending, will you unlock it?
🤝 This game can be played by 4 people, so invite your friends!
🛒 Check out the shop for fun items to troll your friends with!

👍 Like + favorite the game for more stories based off real events

❓ Will you survive your night shifts at the new job...?
